messages:
Elaine (CS): Heads up team — PivotalEdge is going live in sa-east2 tomorrow. They need an ingress CIDR exception for their NAT and a per-route throughput lift for the first 48 hours. Renewal flagged after pilot if metrics look good. Can infra/SRE assist with a temporary headroom bump and header passthrough so they can send a customer_id header? cc @Sofia @Omar :wave:

InfraBot: New request created: REQ-9482. Assigned to Sofia. ETA 2h.

Sofia (SRE): I can do the CIDR and route-level burst. What's the CIDR range and which routes?

Elaine (CS): CIDR: 200.120.34.0/24. Routes: /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings. Throughput: bump from 250 r/s to 1,200 r/s for 48h. Also need header passthrough for X-Customer-ID (we want header_mirror behavior). They also asked to exclude this demo traffic from their credit cap during the window.

Omar (Onboarding): FYI they plan a heavy demo batch at ~02:00 UTC; suggested window 01:30–03:30 UTC. Renewal risk note: if cost creeps up they'll ask about committed capacity — I'll prep a short comparison of Dedicated vs hosted credits for tomorrow's call.

Ravi (Infra Eng): On it. Applying CIDR and header mirror now. Command I'm running:
```
rbctl network allow-cidr --customer pivotaledge --cidr 200.120.34.0/24 --duration 48h
rbctl route update --customer pivotaledge --route /v1/generate:/v1/embeddings --qps 1200
rbctl header set --customer pivotaledge --header X-Customer-ID --mirror true
```

Sofia (SRE): Done for CIDR and header mirroring. Route QPS limit raised to 1,200. I also toggled a temporary billing override so demo traffic won't immediately consume their free credits: billing_exempt=true until 2026-03-24T12:00:00Z. I'll monitor 429s and latency dashboards.

Elaine (CS): Amazing, thanks both. Omar — can you confirm the exact start time with PivotalEdge and ask them to surface any spike patterns? Also please capture qualitative feedback on prompt latency and any edge-case errors. :memo:

Omar (Onboarding): Will message them now and share the checklist (ingress CIDR, expected TPS, example X-Customer-ID headers, and a rollback contact). Looping PM for renewal touchpoint. ETA: I'll update this thread once they ack.

Sofia (SRE): Note for ops: header mirroring will be revoked automatically when the CIDR rule expires. I set an alert to post here on any 5xx > 0.5% or 429 > 1% during the window.

InfraBot: REQ-9482 closed by Sofia (SRE) — 3484321243.
